summary_en: 32,000,000 shares (20.78% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-10 at ¥3,602/share, aggregate limit ¥115.3B. Primary shareholder Mitsubishi Corporation (holding 30.8M shares) has indicated intent to participate. Settlement 2026-08-10.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-exchange transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-07, Toyo Tire Corporation's board approved a single-day treasury share acquisition via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-10. The company will submit a buy order at the ToSTNeT-3 pre-opening session (08:45 JST) at the closing price of 2026-08-07 (¥3,602/share). The acquisition targets 32,000,000 shares (20.78% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) with an aggregate limit of ¥115.3B. The transaction is limited to the specified trading window only; no price changes or execution method variations are planned. Results will be published after the 08:45 trading session. The company states that its primary shareholder Mitsubishi Corporation, which holds 30,822,200 shares, has indicated willingness to participate in this acquisition. Depending on execution, the shareholding structure of major and principal shareholders may change; any such changes will be disclosed promptly.
